_comment: packages/core and packages/ui are vendored duplicates in all three mobile
repos with no shared package (see CLAUDE.md). The files listed here already
differ between copies as of 2026-08-08 and are accepted debt, NOT approval:
reconciling them needs a per-file decision, because some divergence is
deliberate (env.dart carries a different API base per app; rbac.dart models
tenant roles that only mandir-mobile has) and some is a change that was made
in one app and never ported.
The suite fails on any file NOT listed here, so the debt cannot grow silently.
Remove an entry once its copies are reconciled.
